mgmt_bio.text: Joost Farwerck, born in 1965, has more than 31 years of experience at KPN and in the telecom and technology industry, and was appointed chief executive officer and chairman of the Board of Management of Koninklijke KPN NV on 1 December 2019. He joined KPN in 1994 after graduating in law from the University of Amsterdam and has held senior executive positions across several KPN divisions, including senior executive vice president Consumer Residential in 2011 and managing director Netherlands in 2012, with responsibility for the group's Dutch activities. He has been a member of the Board of Management since 2013 and served as chief operating officer from 2014, as well as interim chairman of the Board of Management before his promotion.

sentences.quote: KPN today announces that Chris Figee will leave KPN on 1 November 2026 to join ASM International N.V. (ASM) to be nominated as Chief Financial Officer and member of the Management Board.
sentences.text: CFO Chris Figee, on the Board of Management since February 2020, announced in July 2026 that he would leave KPN on 1 November 2026 to be nominated as CFO of ASM International.

sentences.quote: Vladimir Cibic will be nominated for appointment to the Board of Management as of the AGM in April 2027. At that time, the Supervisory Board also intends to reappoint Wouter Stammeijer and Chantal Vergouw
sentences.text: Figee had served as CFO and member of KPN's Board of Management since 1 February 2020 and leaves on 1 November 2026 for ASM International N.V. On 1 October 2026 KPN named Chief Operating Officer Wouter Stammeijer as CFO effective 1 November and Vladimir Cibic as Chief Technology Officer from the same date, with Cibic to be nominated to the Board of Management at the 2027 AGM, when Stammeijer and Chantal Vergouw (Chief Business Market) are also set for reappointment.

mgmt_recent.text: CFO Chris Figee, on the Board of Management since February 2020, announced in July 2026 that he would leave KPN on 1 November 2026 to be nominated as CFO of ASM International. Figee had served as CFO and member of KPN's Board of Management since 1 February 2020 and leaves on 1 November 2026 for ASM International N.V. On 1 October 2026 KPN named Chief Operating Officer Wouter Stammeijer as CFO effective 1 November and Vladimir Cibic as Chief Technology Officer from the same date, with Cibic to be nominated to the Board of Management at the 2027 AGM, when Stammeijer and Chantal Vergouw (Chief Business Market) are also set for reappointment.

citations.quote: The company said it remains committed to returning all free cash flow to shareholders and completed its EUR 250 million share buyback.

sentences.text: Under chief executive Joost Farwerck, KPN has reported steady delivery against its Connect, Activate and Grow plan, with management stating at the November 2025 strategy update that, at the halfway point of the four-year plan, it had achieved market leadership in both fixed and mobile and further expanded its networks, while reaffirming the 3-3-7 CAGR ambitions and guiding capex below EUR 1bn in 2027.

Capital allocation is anchored on returning all free cash flow: 2025 free cash flow rose 5.8% to EUR 962m, dividend per share is intended to rise about 10% to EUR 0.20 over 2026, and a EUR 250m buyback was completed.
